purpose: Resolve frozen catalogue-level prospective cohort labels to decoded SigLA document IDs before outcome inspection.
rules: Whitespace-only normalization may be used when unique.
A catalogue-level label denoting multiple faces/sides expands to all corresponding decoded document IDs.
No face/side may be selected or discarded based on candidate outcome.
Ambiguous or unmatched labels remain unresolved and are reported; no fuzzy guessing.
